source: owner video, game region only, 28 sampled frames

p5_luminance.note: no true blacks except the final jump-scare frame

fraction_pixels_above_0.9.note: the horizon is pale mint-grey at about 0.86 value, not blown to white

current_build_screenshots.verdict: too much pure black (the void above the walls), not enough lifted mid-tones

hue_notes: Water hue is olive-to-leaf green (85 to 113 degrees), saturation 0.32 to 0.52, value 0.35 to 0.69. It is NOT teal or cyan. Slabs and walls hue 38 to 48 degrees (warm tan), saturation 0.32 to 0.56. Fog is nearly neutral pale mint (hue about 80, saturation 0.07 to 0.14).

audio.note: A streamer's voice is mixed over the game audio, so absolute spectra include speech. The quiet seconds (about 7 to 9, 28, 52 to 55) show the game's own room tone at roughly -46 dBFS with a broad mid-weighted spectrum and no strong hum.
